app.name: Resolvara
app.short_description: Audit your AI agent's billed resolutions against a stricter, public test.
app.long_description:
### Check the AI resolutions you are billed for

Zendesk bills AI agents per automated resolution. Resolvara checks each of those resolutions against a stricter, published test and shows you which ones did not hold up, with the evidence for each ticket.

### What it checks

For every AI-agent ticket that Zendesk counts as an automated resolution, Resolvara looks for signs that the customer's problem was not actually solved:

1. The same customer came back with a new ticket within the look-ahead window (7 days by default).
2. The ticket was reopened.
3. A human agent had to reply after the AI.
4. The customer left a negative CSAT rating.

You get the share of billed resolutions that fail, the reasons, a week-by-week view, how much the window changes the result, and a CSV of the flagged ticket IDs to raise with your Zendesk account team.

### Your data stays in your account

The audit runs entirely in your browser tab. Resolvara reads your own tickets through the Zendesk Apps framework with your signed-in session. It needs no API token, stores nothing, sends nothing to Resolvara or any third party, and never combines data across accounts. The only network traffic is to your own Zendesk. Privacy policy: https://resolvara.com/privacy

### About Resolvara

Resolvara is a free, open-source auditor of AI-agent billing. The method (the Strict Resolution Standard) and the source code are public: https://github.com/younesbag/resolvara. You can also audit a CSV or JSON export from Zendesk, Intercom, Ada, Gorgias or any other helpdesk at https://resolvara.com.
app.installation_instructions:
Resolvara needs no configuration and no API token. Reading tickets uses Zendesk's incremental ticket export, which only administrators can call.

1. Install the app.
2. Optionally, under role restrictions, limit it to Administrators.
3. Open Resolvara from the left navigation bar.
4. Under Read from this Zendesk, choose a period (30, 60 or 90 days) and click Run audit. Large accounts take a few minutes.
5. Review the results and download the CSV of flagged tickets if you want to raise them with Zendesk.

To audit a file instead, choose Upload an export file. To remove the app, uninstall it from Admin Center: it keeps no data, so nothing is left behind.
